rationale: Correction history: Sequence 1 shipped the d1 backend as a stub: _read_raw and _write_raw raised NotImplementedError('d1 backend requires the REST client (Task 3.5)'). The transport is a module-level _d1_request so it is substitutable in tests; the store refuses to run without CLOUDFLARE_D1_API_TOKEN rather than silently discarding a run.
